name: Have I seen you somewhere before?
source:
Alone at night.
Walking in the rain.
Left by his girlfriend.

A lost Mads Mikkelsen's lookalike is searching for love on a solitary night. Wandering through the city he finds himself in a speed-dating session, encountering people that are more than meets the eye.

Will you help him find love?

[From [url=https://team-soletude.itch.io/have-i-met-you-somewhere-before]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
晚上独自一人。
走在雨中。
是他女朋友留下的。

失踪的麦斯·米科尔森的长相在一个孤独的夜晚寻找爱情。他在这座城市里闲逛，发现自己正在进行一场快速约会，遇到了一些不为人知的人。

你会帮助他找到爱情吗？

[来自[url=https://team-soletude.itch.io/have-i-met-you-somewhere-before]Itch.io[/url]]
